project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA (Vite) — a marine waste management / blue circular economy prototype. Single-page app, client-side routing (react-router-dom v6), no backend: auth and trading are simulated in React context + localStorage.
build_system: Vite 5 (vite build) with `tsc -b` (project references) typecheck first. npm scripts: dev=vite, build=`tsc -b && vite build`, preview=vite preview. Path alias `@/*`->src/* (configured in both vite.config.ts and tsconfig.app.json). Tailwind CSS 3 via PostCSS. The actual repo dir name on disk is `aquasoursehub` (with an 's' after 'aqua'); a similarly-spelled dir without the 's' does NOT exist — always use `c:\Users\THIS PC\Desktop\aquasoursehub`.
test_framework: None. There is no test script and no test runner installed. Verification is: `npm run build` (runs `tsc -b` then `vite build`) must pass with zero TS errors, plus a manual grep check. Typecheck-only: `npx tsc -b` (or `npx tsc -b --force` to ignore incremental cache).
test_command: npx tsc -b --force   (no unit tests exist; build IS the verification gate)
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run build` from the repo root; it must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors and Vite must produce dist/. 2) Run the grep check in the Verify section of each FEAT and confirm no old role-name hits remain as role identifiers (comments left as open-point notes are allowed). 3) Manually confirm: RegisterPage offers exactly 3 roles; RolesSection shows exactly 3 roles; each role routes to its own dashboard; RegisterPage has a verification step before the account is active.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Build writes dist/ and tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo / tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo. These are build artifacts; do NOT commit dist/ or the .tsbuildinfo files. Do not commit any temp logs you create (e.g. build_log.txt, tsc_clean.txt).
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Paths contain a space ('THIS PC') — always quote them. The repo is a real git repo (base sha 087156b6db0513e7c199c0b28079438f6cdc0ee6); there is NO worktree and NO separate branch checked out — edit the repo in place. Do not push. Do not create a worktree. Node may launch under a debugger inspector in this environment (harmless 'Debugger listening' lines in build output) — ignore those lines, only the tsc/vite output and the exit code matter.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md present. Keep existing code style (dark glass UI, Tailwind utility classes, inline numeric font sizes like text-[13px], Lucide icons). Do NOT add npm dependencies. Do NOT change the tech stack, build config (vite/tsconfig), or the Tailwind config. Preserve all non-role logic (auth flow, form validation, localStorage persistence, waste categories).
key_patterns: Components are default-exported .tsx under src/components or src/pages. Context providers in src/context (AuthContext, TradingContext) expose a `useX` hook and throw if used outside the provider. Landing-page data is centralised in src/data/landingData.ts and rendered by section components in src/components/sections/*.tsx (each consumes an array and maps it — update the DATA, not the section, unless copy is hardcoded in the section). Icons: direct imports from 'lucide-react' for components used in JSX; the string->component mapper src/components/ui/Icon.tsx is used by landing sections that reference icon names as strings in landingData — ADD any new string icon name to BOTH the import list and the `icons` map in Icon.tsx. CRITICAL TypeScript note: type icon-typed fields (NavItem.icon, StatCard icon prop, WASTE_ICONS Record value, RoleOption.Icon) as `LucideIcon` imported from 'lucide-react' — NOT as `React.FC<{size?:number;...}>`, which is incompatible with Lucide's ForwardRefExoticComponent and causes TS2322. tsconfig has noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters + noFallthroughCasesInSwitch: never leave an unused import/variable/parameter and make every switch case return (or break).
